limitations_and_followups: No live exit, leverage, pyramiding or re-entry behavior changed.
Six-hour shadow windows are fixed and censor still-open arms; they do not establish multi-day holding profitability.
Trades already fully closed at the first full-hour fork cannot be resurrected in a residual comparison.
MAINNET positioning and SANDBOX price/fill/funding sources are not mixed.
Counterfactual SANDBOX funding remains unknown, not zero; modeled gross or fee-adjusted values are not realized net profit.
A completed research job is not a complete statistical study; inspect per-report status and profitability_valid.
Raw positioning observations have bounded 30-day retention. Compact append-only campaign reports and run records currently retain history; monitor size before adding an archival policy.
On redeploy, recheck dedicated role attributes, memberships and forbidden privileges; the grants file does not erase historical unrelated grants.
Historical snapshots backfilled now cannot prove historical availability. Validate new hypotheses on unseen future dates and preserve failed/control cases.
rollback_scope: Disable only the two new research timers and stop their research oneshots if needed; retain research tables and do not touch trading services.
